svg.aria-label: A tour through Storage Manager: Overview: How much you can free, and the steps to get there.; Folders: Every folder sorted by size; a click opens it.; Large Files: Everything above the size you choose, as tiles or a list.; Clean Up: Pick what may go. Running apps and macOS stay untouched.; Duplicates: Extra copies go to the Trash, after you confirm.; Unused Apps: Apps you have not opened for months, with their size.
